nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui configuration for the React app, defining the default style, Tailwind setup (slate base color, CSS variables), and path aliases for components, ui, lib, utils, and hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: shadcn CLI reads this file to scaffold components into the configured alias directories.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry document for the Vite-powered React UI, mounting the app at the #root div and loading the main.tsx module script plus the global stylesheet.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @org/ui app declaring runtime UI dependencies including Radix UI primitives (dialog, select, label, slot, separator) and react-datepicker.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the UI application build, extending the workspace base config with React JSX, bundler module resolution, DOM lib, and Vite/Nx typings while excluding test files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bundler moduleResolution and project references to compile app sources from src/ separately from tests.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript solution file for the UI app that uses project references to delegate compilation to tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.spec.json, extending the workspace base config.
